item.title: AIM movers: Central Asia Metals profit trebles and Nexteq diversifies
item.summary: Gaming and broadcast technology supplier Nexteq (LON: NXQ) has diversified its customer base through Densitron winning an order for customised displays for electric delivery vehicles from a supplier of automotive electronics. Production should start before the end of the year and should build up over three years. There are no changes to forecasts.
